steps.en: Install it once — Claude Code plugin or npm CLI
steps.zh: 装一次——Claude Code 插件或 npm CLI

steps.en: Hand a whole feature to autopilot in natural language
steps.zh: 把一整个功能用自然语言交给 autopilot
steps.code: /autopilot "build a REST API for managing tasks"

steps.en: Runs the staged pipeline plan → PRD → exec → verify → fix, looping on failures
steps.zh: 按规划→PRD→执行→验证→修复流水线干活，失败进循环

steps.en: Routes each subtask to a cheaper or stronger Claude tier; the HUD shows every agent
steps.zh: 把子任务路由到更便宜或更强的模型档位，HUD 实时展示

value.en: A feature planned, built, verified, and re-fixed by a team of Claude agents — you review the result, not every step
value.zh: 一整个功能由一队 Claude agent 规划、实现、验证、返工——你审最终结果，不盯每一步
